title: David Lapham
description: "I was only seven when my parents took me to see STAR WARS," remembers David Lapham. "Wow. All little kids deserve a place like that." In 1990, just a month before marrying his beautiful wife Maria, Lapham bezan working as an artist for Valiant Comics. While helping to build the Valiant universe, he created SHADOWMAN and co-directed the lives of THE HARBINGER KIDS. Additionally, Lapham has contributed to MAGNUM, RAI and the H.A.R.D. CORPS.
